source: his 2026-10-26 07:12, variations on 26a: "Cargo ship orbitting wreakage has part, get and take to sat"
_note: THE SPACE BOARD FAMILY, 2: THE WRECKED FREIGHTER. The freighter bringing the satellite's replacement part broke up in
orbit; the part is in a sealed crate in the wreckage. Pick it up, fit it. Both stops are in space.
TWO ORBIT BEATS, A PICKUP THEN A DELIVER, in ONE space cell: the wreck and the satellite are two markers in the same
orbit. Unproven: S13 carried one use. Whether the cell has two markers to give, and how a pickup works from a ship
(vanilla's space cargo is looted by flying close and activating), is Eliza's.
MODEL: the crate is wreckcargocrate01 (03a's, seen on the ground). Whether the wreckage itself is a placed model or
the cell's own debris is hers and his; a ship wreck in space is not on the approved list.
The broadcast plays at the wreck, his 1500 m in space (26a). Closing line on the radio. Pay: med, capped.

CARD 2026-11-10 (his 11-04 ruling, a posting by whoever set the job: no payer label, no payment line; his 11-10 'we still have all those X Contract things'). Was: "Private Contract. Recover the satellite part from the freighter wreckage over <Planet> and fit it. Payment on contract completion."

Vanilla's drifting space container, Loot_Space_CargoModule01 'Cargo Module' (about 8 x 4 x 3 m, the smallest vanilla one; archived, so the base's bounds). Measured against Kim's freighterwreck01 by box: it touches the 10T-Hauler part's box and is 0.2 to 0.4 m from two more, so a clip is possible; his eye at the glass decides, and a reorigin of her wreck is the fix if so.

message.title: Satellite Repaired
message.text: The amplifier slots into place. The satellite's beacon comes back on, slow and steady.

say: That's the signal back. At least something off that freighter made it.

broadcast: Our freighter broke up out here. The part was in a sealed crate, and if anything survived, it's that. Find it, then take it to the satellite.
_speech: The freighter's owners, so the loss is theirs and the joke at the end is a little rueful. Voice: Daniel (Steady Broadcaster), already in four recipes; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency.
